get.description: Requires workflow:read. Graph data is omitted from list items.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Negative values are treated as zero.

get.description: Requires workflow:read. Includes graphData. Definitions are published through the workflow publication API.

post.description: Requires workflow_instance:start. Starts a published definition as the authenticated user. An omitted or empty title uses the definition name.

formData.description: Submitted form map, validated against the selected definition. Non-object/non-array values are treated as an empty form. Empty forms may be encoded as {} or []. People and department fields accept UUIDs; users fields accept ordered lists of up to 50 unique UUIDs. Configured candidate ranges are enforced by the server. Media and image fields accept uploaded media IDs and require media:read access.

title.description: Optional string title. Empty or non-string values use the definition name.

get.summary: List workflows started by the current user

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Negative values are treated as zero.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Recognized statuses are RUNNING, AGREE, REJECT and CANCEL; unrecognized values are ignored.

get.summary: Read a workflow instance and its approval progress
get.description: Requires workflow_instance:access. Only participants may read an instance. Includes the immutable graph and submitted form, approval stages, tasks and history. Form data, schema, graph properties and form-change history are projected through the selected task or copy permissions. Returns formVersion, formPermissions, formContexts, formContextId, formContextRequired and formChanges for approval workflows.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Own task or copy ID selecting the form permission context. Multiple contexts require an explicit choice; visibility is never unioned.

post.description: Requires workflow_instance:start. Only the actual initiator may cancel; pending tasks are canceled with the instance.

reason.description: Optional string reason. Non-string values are treated as an empty reason.

get.summary: List pending tasks assigned to the current user

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Negative values are treated as zero.

get.summary: List tasks completed by the current user

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Negative values are treated as zero.

post.description: Requires workflow_task:decide. The task must belong to the authenticated user. Empty comments are treated as absent. Form changes, audit and approval are atomic. Node-required fields must be complete before approval; rejection and return do not save changes.

409.description: The form version is missing or stale, or the task is no longer pending.

400.description: Malformed patch, invalid value, or missing node-required value.

comment.description: Optional string comment. Empty, whitespace-only and non-string values are treated as absent.

formData.description: A patch containing only changed editable fields. Hidden, read-only and unknown fields are rejected; omitted fields are retained. People and department fields accept UUIDs; users fields accept ordered lists of up to 50 unique UUIDs. Configured candidate ranges are enforced by the server. Media and image fields accept uploaded media IDs and require media:read access.

formVersion.description: Version from the authorized instance response. Required for a nonempty formData patch; stale versions return 409.

post.description: Requires workflow_task:decide. The task must belong to the authenticated user; a nonblank comment is required.

comment.description: WorkflowService rejects an absent or whitespace-only comment.

get.summary: List copies received by the current user
get.description: Requires workflow_instance:access. The recipient is derived from the authenticated context; client-supplied user IDs are ignored.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Negative values are treated as zero.

post.description: Requires workflow_instance:access and receipt ownership. Repeated calls preserve the first read timestamp. Reading does not decide or advance the workflow.

204.description: The receipt is marked as read.

403.description: Required privileges are missing or the receipt does not belong to the current user.

post.summary: Transfer a task or add a mandatory parallel reviewer
post.description: Requires workflow_task:decide and ownership of a current pending task. The target must be an active eligible member, distinct from existing stage participants. Transfer preserves the original approval position; add-sign is a separate mandatory group. All added reviewers must approve and any may reject. Both operations are serialized by instance and audited separately from votes. The operation must be enabled in the immutable node snapshot.

action.description: Built-in actions: transfer, add-sign. The node must enable the operation.

post.summary: Return to the initiator for changes
post.description: Requires workflow_task:decide and ownership of a current task. A nonblank comment is required. Cancels active tasks and executions without terminating the instance. The return operation must be enabled in the immutable node snapshot.

comment.description: WorkflowService rejects an absent or whitespace-only comment.

targetNodeId.description: Optional approval stage to resume after the initiator resubmits.

post.summary: Resubmit a returned instance in a new round
post.description: Requires workflow_instance:start and initiator ownership. The expected round must match. Uses the saved graph and input schema; business subscribers may reject changes to immutable fields. formData is a patch: omitted fields are retained. Frozen business inputs cannot be submitted as editable fields. Changes are privately audited.

formData.description: A patch containing only changed editable fields. Hidden, read-only and unknown fields are rejected; omitted fields are retained. People and department fields accept UUIDs; users fields accept ordered lists of up to 50 unique UUIDs. Configured candidate ranges are enforced by the server. Media and image fields accept uploaded media IDs and require media:read access.

formVersion.description: Version from the authorized instance response. Required for a nonempty formData patch; stale versions return 409.

post.summary: Execute a declared plugin approval operation
post.description: Requires workflow_task:decide, task ownership, a current pending task and an operation enabled in the immutable node snapshot. Eligibility is checked under the instance lock. A plugin handles ApprovalTaskOperationExtension; core records a separate operation audit on success. Built-in operations use their dedicated endpoints.

action.description: Installed plugin operation declared through ApprovalOperationRegistrationEvent.

payload.description: Plugin-owned input map. Omission or an empty array is accepted as an empty map; explicit null is invalid. The input payload is never automatically audited.

post.description: Requires workflow_instance:start and ownership of a running instance. Rechecks current tasks under the instance lock. Reminders have a 600-second cooldown per task. Delivery retries reuse the same delivery ID. This action never changes approval decisions.

204.description: A private reminder was recorded for eligible pending approvers.

403.description: The caller is not the initiator or lacks start permission.

409.description: No current task is eligible, the cooldown is active, or a delivery is pending.

post.description: Requires workflow_task:decide and ownership of a handling task. The optional comment is recorded with the completion.

comment.description: WorkflowService rejects an absent or whitespace-only comment.
